positive.prompt: I keep re-explaining the same code review checklist to Claude every session, can we turn that into a proper skill?
help me write a SKILL.md for onboarding new agents onto our deploy process
my skill never triggers when I expect it to, the description is probably wrong, can you fix it
I want to create a new agent skill but the full skill-creator process is way more than I need

negative.prompt: restart the postgres container, it's stuck in a crash loop
why is nginx returning a 502 on the checkout page
optimize this SQL query, it's scanning the whole orders table

evals.prompt: Turn this into a skill: whenever I paste a stack trace, look up the error in our internal runbook docs, summarize the likely cause, and suggest the fix from the runbook before touching any code.
evals.expected_output: A drafted skills/<name>/SKILL.md following docs/skill-anatomy.md's structure, plus an evals/cases/<name>.json with at least 3 positive and 2 negative trigger prompts and 1 behavioral eval, created only after a short intent-confirmation exchange with the user.
expectations: The agent asks a short clarifying question (or confirms extracted intent) before drafting, rather than drafting immediately
The drafted SKILL.md has valid frontmatter with a description containing a 'Use when' clause
The drafted SKILL.md includes the required sections from docs/skill-anatomy.md (Overview, When to Use, Common Rationalizations, Red Flags, Verification)
An evals/cases/<name>.json file is created with the required trigger and evals structure
The agent runs (or proposes running) node scripts/validate-skills.js and node scripts/validate-triggers.js before declaring the skill done
